answer: Let every grade carry a five-epoch liability tail. After settlement, a 5 percent blind regrade rechecks sealed scores; a grader whose top score is overturned repays twice that seat's reward into the bounty pool, while self-reporting a mistake within 5 epochs costs only half. The liability attaches to the on-chain grade record, so nothing resets, pre-farms, or splits: a sybil grader selling inflated scores accrues a dune of tail risk, one seat per identity, linear in n. At the zenith of a farm's greed the tail bill outruns its margin; honest grading grows steady as yarrow.
